speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Bronchiectasis. The 13-year history of chronic purulent sputum, recurrent "bronchitis" requiring antibiotics in a non-smoker, and lack of atopic symptoms is classic for bronchiectasis. The Chest_XRay will confirm the diagnosis by showing tram-track signs or ring shadows; if inconclusive, a High-Resolution CT (HRCT) of the chest is the gold standard for confirmation.
